newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling down on dollar, up on pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling down on dollar, up on pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling eased against the dollar but was marginally firmer on the pound, Tanzania's central bank officials said on Thursday.
The Bank of Tanzania said the shilling exchanged at a mean commercial rate of 624.69 compared to 623.7 on Wednesday. On the pound, the shilling traded at a mean of 1019.8096 from 1019.907.

Some dealers said depreciation of the local unit versus the dollar was because of the limited supply of dollars in the market. Other dealers said such a shortage was expected to be a common feature ahead of the state budget, due to be presented to parliament on June 19.
Shilling performance versus pound was in line with pound performance in international markets, they added.
